officialBook: Montross and Canzona, US Marine Operations in Korea1950–1953, VolII The Inchon-Seoul Operation, HQUSMC1955
reproductionProvenance: Project Gutenberg transcription from HathiTrust page images, primary USMC-authored book content; image maps visually inspected

maps.title: Seizure of Wolmi-do, 3rd Bn 5th Marines, 15 Sept1950
maps.sourceGeometry: Historic island shoreline is visible; arrows represent company attacks, not control boundaries. Text p91 states Radio Hill secured by0800 and control of island/harbor followed.
maps.closedControlCandidate: Wolmi-do island extent could be bounded by its historic coast with explicit textual whole-island capture evidence; still requires historic shore georeferencing and source tracing. No mainland bridgehead supplied.
maps.coordinateBasis: North arrow and0–1000yard scale; no visible graticule, grid CRS or datum. No geographic registration yet.

maps.title: Seizure of Red Beach, 5th Marines
maps.sourceGeometry: Dashed company positions and disjoint local defensive perimeters, beach and urban coast.
maps.closedControlCandidate: No continuous coast-to-coast overall ownership boundary. Cannot fill gaps between companies or confuse arrows with control.
maps.coordinateBasis: North arrow and0–500yard scale; no graticule/CRS/datum.

maps.title: Seizure of Blue Beach, 1st Marines
maps.sourceGeometry: Separate company positions, advance arrows, coastal features and objectives; some small tactical perimeters.
maps.closedControlCandidate: No complete common mainland bridgehead envelope. Tactical company perimeters do not prove total ownership partition.
maps.coordinateBasis: North arrow and0–1000yard scale; no graticule/CRS/datum.

maps.title: Marine attacks D-plus1
maps.sourceGeometry: Dashed fronts split by units; solid O-1/O-2/O-3 and Force Beachhead Line are named operational lines and must not automatically become achieved control.
maps.closedControlCandidate: Local fronts only; source does not justify filling entire planned force beachhead area as observed16September ownership.
maps.coordinateBasis: North arrow, mile/yard scales; no geographic grid.

maps.title: General situation18September
maps.sourceGeometry: Enemy concentration circles and movement arrows, unit positions.
maps.closedControlCandidate: None. This is not a territorial control boundary map.
maps.coordinateBasis: North arrow and0–5mile scale; no grid.

maps.title: The battle of Seoul
maps.dateTimeLabel: Approximate X Corps front2400 27Sep; attack arrows25/26/27Sep
maps.sourceGeometry: Explicitly approximate front across local urban map, clipped at top/east map limits; other dash-dot lines are not the same front.
maps.closedControlCandidate: Useful local front source for27Sep2400, not a closed nationwide or local ownership polygon and not a separately observed28Sep state.
maps.coordinateBasis: North arrow and0–4000yard scale; no grid/CRS/datum.

maps.coordinateBasis: North arrow and0–1000yard scale; no grid.

materialConclusion: Historic Wolmi-do shoreline plus explicit island-capture narrative is a viable future limited island ownership candidate. The inspected mainland maps do not establish the complete dated bridgehead/control envelope required to replace the DVA strategic candidate without invention. No digitization or source admission performed.
